points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: M0.15/Re20 canonical packages pass independent structural validation; other required cases missing/partial and Re200 explicitly failed.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Original all-case validator stops at missing M0.80. Separate read-only validation passes M0.15 and Re20.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Two steady cases meet reported residual targets; M0.15 laminar diagnostic incomplete and Re200 t=1 failed.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 final CD2.033 and near-zero lift are plausible with stable last100 drag; M0.15 CD0.000705 near zero but relative late variation substantial.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Delivered PDF contains histories, but NACA zoom misses body and full-domain Re20 field/vorticity shrinks wake to a few pixels.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report honestly describes short Re200 and absent other cases, but incorrectly frames only three benchmark cases and denies iteration-time full mesh.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Sibling PDF corresponds to tracked TeX; tables/figures trace to cases but figure blobs are uncommitted and exact binary binding unproven.
